operator-walkthrough.deferred: operator-pending (2026-10-08, camera N-series PR B): each camera card on Admin > Lot replaces the 'steady today' / 'N drops today' text with a HealthTimeline strip (today's state segments over the business window: emerald HEALTHY, sky EXPECTED_SOLAR_OFFLINE, grey UNKNOWN for the stretch no row covers, amber/red for the rest; the current state and how long it has held above it; the changes and drops count beneath it), and the trust strip gains a 'Watched today' chip (the sign camera's HEALTHY share of business time so far, one cell per business hour, 'shop not open yet' before open, 'no business hours today' without hours) that turns amber under 80% because comparisons with the baseline are then withheld. What the operator sees on the first day after deploy: segments only from the first recorded row onward (UNKNOWN before it, since nothing predates the day) and the read-derived states from the first 5-minute alert tick. Also in this PR, the four nickstire Codex findings on #2920, each confirmed before fixing: lot.activity counts episodes the way the headline counter does (COUNT(DISTINCT ... COALESCE(episodeId, visitId))), so lotDataConfidence compares like with like; the open-only floor board is read oldest first, so its LIMIT keeps the longest-waiting cars instead of dropping them; a restarted edge reads 'warming' (its card says so) rather than blind until heartbeatSeq x heartbeatSeconds covers the blind-inference window; a recovery after a frozen-frame alert is reported even while the camera is 'quiet', because the prior alert's own vision facet decides, not the shared state name.
